evidence: ClaimDefinition retains required_evidence, required_surface_ids, required_tool_ids, required_decision_ids, and false_pass_controls.
ClaimGuard never consumes those fields and checks only nonempty generic envelope maps plus matching context/candidate/surface/ceiling strings.
One generic DirectObservation passes CL-PACKAGE, CL-INSTALL, and CL-ORCHESTRATION despite their distinct multi-item evidence and closure requirements.
The locked/offline 4/4 suite encodes this false-pass rather than rejecting omitted or partial obligations.
decisive_finding.impact: A claim can elevate without its registry-required behavior, surfaces, tools, decisions, or false-pass controls, defeating the exact claim ceiling contract.

required_correction: Represent every registry-required evidence item, surface, tool, decision, and false-pass control as an exact candidate-bound observed obligation rather than a generic nonempty map.
Require complete exact-set coverage before decision elevation and reject unknown, duplicate, omitted, partial, contradicted, stale, wrong-surface, or cross-candidate obligation evidence.
Bind each satisfied obligation to method, independent producer/reviewer, artifact/output digest, freshness, context, candidate, and supported ceiling; a bare asserted identifier is not sufficient.
Preserve rejected obligation evidence and causal reasons in deterministic projections.
Add per-claim false-pass matrices proving CL-PACKAGE, CL-INSTALL, CL-ORCHESTRATION, CL-RELEASE, and CL-COMPLETION cannot pass with one generic observation or any one omitted required item.
preserved_evidence: Exact six-file identity and 14-node registry DAG were independently reproduced.
Focused 4/4 tests pass but are insufficient because they encode the false-pass.
Typed WorkerResult acceptance remains withheld because review stopped after the material semantic defect.
claim_ceiling: No HCT-CLAIMS source acceptance, public integration, passed live claim, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim claim-authority behavior, public integration, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
